display_long_description:
Orbital Exploration – View planets in stunning 3D as they appear in real-time, floating in space. Travel to and interact with celestial bodies from various orbital perspectives.

Realistic Planetary Details – Each planet is designed with high-fidelity textures, realistic atmospheres, and accurate surface details based on real NASA data.

Educational Lecture – Engage in the learning experiences where you uncover planetary facts, scientific discoveries, and historical space missions.

Satellites Exploration– learn about and observe the major moons of the solar system as they have been captured by numerous space missions.

Experience
Solar System View– in a fully immersive 3D mode observe 8 Planets and Pluto as they orbit around the sun, forming our Cosmic neighbourhood. Increase orbital speed to see the rotation and the trajectory of the planets. See system in 3 different views to sense the scale, rotation and light on different planets.

Choose a Planet or Moons– Select any planet or moons in our solar system to bring it into your space using VR. View a planet with the corresponding moon(s) as they orbit a planet, explore planet’s surface features, as they switch between day and night cycles.
